name: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger Vol. 5
original_name: グリザイア ファントムトリガー Vol. 5
source:
A few weeks have passed since SORD successfully resolved the Kitaoka University terrorist incident - albeit with some sacrifices - when Murasaki's older sister Yuuki returns to Japan to rejoin Class A. 
Being more sociable and capable than her sister,
Yuuki immediately befriends the other students and builds a trusting relationship with them.

"There's no reason for me to be at Mihama anymore..."

As Murasaki starts questioning her raison d'etre, she reminisces about the time when she first me Haruto. 
Lamenting his lack of experience, he had come to her village hidden deep in the mountains in search of new skills. 
Where could he find this supposed "secret art" that is said to have been passed down for generations...?

"I'll never forgive you...!!"
"It's okay... Don't worry... I'm not... going anywhere... I'm here with you..."
"I'm stumped... It's exactly as she said -  and there's no way to cut a phantom..."
"Come on. Chin up... Show me your courage..."

Their fateful meeting was also the beginning of a tragic story...

"Won't you... give me the order to kill my sister?"

[From [url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html]English Official Website[/url]]
translation:
自从SORD成功解决北冈大学恐怖事件（尽管做出了一些牺牲）以来几周过去了，紫的姐姐Yuuki回到日本重新加入A班。
比姐姐更善于交际、更能干，
Yuuki立即与其他学生成为朋友，并与他们建立了信任关系。

“我已经没有理由再呆在美滨了……”

当紫开始质疑她存在的理由时，她回忆起第一次见到春人的时候。
他感叹自己经验不足，来到她深山里的村庄寻找新技能。
哪里可以找到这种据说世代相传的“秘术”……？

“我永远不会原谅你……！！”
“没关系……别担心……我不会……去任何地方……我在这儿陪着你……”
“我被难住了……确实如她所说——而且没有办法斩断幻影……”
“来吧，抬起头来……让我看看你的勇气……”

他们宿命的相遇，也是一个悲惨故事的开始……

“你不会……下令杀掉我的妹妹吗？”

[来自[url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html]英文官方网站[/url]]
